about: The passage dossiers, in reading order of the files listed. Each file holds dossiers written by hand; tools/dossiers.py checks every quotation and gathers the rest from the library.

kinds.image: An image or likeness Plato draws (eikōn): the sun, the line, the cave.
kinds.myth: A story told as a story (mythos): Er, the charioteer, Atlantis.
kinds.argument: An argument famous as an argument: recollection, the third man.
kinds.scene: A scene of the drama: the death of Socrates, the oracle.
kinds.method: A method shown at work: division, hypothesis, the second sailing.
kinds.doctrine: A doctrine set out at length: the world soul, the receptacle, the elements.
kinds.saying: A saying famous on its own: the unexamined life, philosopher-kings.

groups.republic-images: The images at the centre of the Republic: the sun, the line and the cave, which Socrates ties together.
groups.judgment-myths: The myths of the soul's judgment after death.
groups.cosmology: The making of the cosmos in the Timaeus.
groups.eros: Love and the ascent of the soul.
groups.socrates: The life and death of Socrates.
groups.soul: The soul, its parts and its likenesses.
